scope: Existing development16 only; no new preference predictions or scores
label_scope: Released aggregated winner for visual consistency, according to official dataset card and paper; no subject-only component or individual rater ballots in released schema

instruction_scope_examples.instruction: Replace the current arid background with a vibrant, bustling city street scene at golden hour, featuring tall buildings, illuminated streetlights, and a warm, golden-orange sunset sky, ensuring the lighting on the subjects is seamlessly integrated with the new ambient light.
instruction_scope_examples.interpretation: The instruction explicitly allows subject-lighting integration. Pixelwise/color invariance of the entire foreground is not implied by visual-consistency labels.
